FIELD GUIDE

How the machine works
Place a result token only when all predecessor results occupy registers; delete results freely and recompute later. Output two sinks with three registers and a calculation budget.
Choose what to retain across shared subexpressions; deleting a cheap intermediate may permit a costly branch, but destroys reuse.
